summary: Repaired STU-003: the 'Many are called' subsection of sections/30-the-wedding-garment.tex withdraws the two-witness and 'Gregory and Aquinas do not weigh the numbers' claims and reports, beside Augustine (Sermo 90.4) and Hilary (22.7), Gregory's omne malorum corpus (38.14) and his many bad and few good in the Church with the ark and threshing floor (38.8), Aquinas's reason joined to Mt 7:14 (Venice p. 282, page image re-read), and Irenaeus's former-covenant comparison (IV.36.6), keeping Gregory's humility and mercy (38.14, 16) and Jerome's non initia sed finis; the closing limit now says the saying itself names no number and no longer narrates restraint.
